scenicChapters.title: German Alpine Road
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 23 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

munich-bavarian-alps-chiemgau-lakes-and-.story: Out of Munich and back again: 317 km, roughly 5 h 46 in the saddle. It goes by way of Samerberg, Berchtesgaden and Bad Endorf. The highest point is about 1,250 m. Long stretches are under trees.
